hook: Microbial community dynamics seen through a few observables compress into surprisingly few latent dimensions.
summary: Variational autoencoders were used to find the smallest latent dimension that reconstructs observed microbial population dynamics. That dimension was far below the community's apparent complexity and grew linearly with the number of observables. The pattern held across simulations, engineered and environmental communities, and human microbiomes, but it supports only selected prediction tasks.
title: Linear scaling reveals low-dimensional structure in observable microbial dynamics.
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
